headline: Is NetApp (NTAP) Fully Priced After Its Proxy Filing?
summary: NetApp (NTAP) has come into focus after filing a preliminary proxy statement on July 16, 2026, urging shareholders to vote against a proposal that would allow certain actions to be approved by written consent.
